name: SD Timer – Live Time Tracker for Frontend & Backend
author: Sadhan Pal

sections.description:
Top WordPress time tracker plugin to make the best of your time. Increase your time management on wordpress skill using this plugin.

Plugin Documentation: https://wordpress.org/plugins/sd-timer

Live Demo

Key Features

  • Very simple.
  • Set timer.
  • Work on WP frontend and backend.
  • Red and Green signal.
  • Overtime alert.
  • 24 hours auto reset.

[UPDATE] We promise updates at the right time

SD Timer is a Time Tracker plugin that lets you count times how long you are woring for a day.

Video Tutorial

How To Use

After you have installed the plugin, you will see a SD Timer item in your admin dashboard menu.
Click on it. Then there you will get all the advantages of this plugin.

  1. You can Set Timer.
  2. You can edit time setup if you change your mind.

You’re done!
sections.installation:
This is one way you can install and use the plugin:

  1. Install SD Timer either via the WordPress.org plugin repository or by uploading the files to your server.
  2. Activate SD Timer.
  3. Go to ‘SD Timer’ from the dashboard and set up your Time.
sections.faq:
Who should use SD Timer?

Anybody who run wordpress website and work on it. Basically,who want to manage time perfectly on WordPress.

Do I need to have coding skills to use SD Timer?

Absolutely not.

Timer is not showing properly. What should I do?

Clear your cache and try again.
